serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Melissa: It’s only him. You: What are you doing here, Melissa? Melissa: I have a day off so I decided to help Annalie around since she’s recuperating. #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: I already regret my decision since she’s more annoying than usual. Lady Annalie: Melissa… *cough*{{wi}} who is it? #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: I already told you. It’s Anon. You: I was told that she should be fine if she took some rest, but her voice and face seem pained. What’s going on? Melissa: She’s fine. She just wants to be spoiled, that’s all. You: Uwah… Melissa: Yeah… #Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised Lady Annalie: Hey! I can hear you! You: Oh, her voice is back to normal. #Annalie.face.sad Lady Annalie: Are you two making fun of me? The doctor said that I could’ve died, you know?! Melissa: He didn’t say anything even remotely like that. I guess I was worried for nothing. If she can go around and joke like that, she’s fine. You: Oh, right. I almost forgot. You: Do you have time to go bowling in the near future, Melissa? Melissa: I would have to check on my schedule, but I think so. You: Great! You: And you, Annalie, take your time and come back to health. Maybe you will be able to go with us next time after this. #Annalie.face.shocked Lady Annalie: Next time?! What about this time?! You: You are sick, aren’t you? We can’t risk you getting another injury. #Annalie.face.sad Lady Annalie: No~ I’m not THAT sick, I promise~ Let me go with you, ok? You: I will let Melissa decide, since she’s the one taking care of you. Melissa: Understood. You: Alright. I will be going now. You: Heal soon, Annalie! Bye! Melissa: I’m going too. I don’t want to waste my whole free day. I will check on you later. Lady Annalie: Sure. See you later~
